title: Ignition Lockout
shortDescription: Three failed ignition attempts caused lockout.
fullDescription: Lennox GWB8/GWM-IE boilers attempt three trials. E1 = failure. Usual suspects: no gas, dirty rod, weak igniter, or plugged condensate trap on condensing units.
safetyWarning: Do not reset repeatedly - gas buildup risk.

fixSteps.title: Pro service
fixSteps.instruction: Clean rod, check igniter and gas pressure.

whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Flame Lost During Run
fullDescription: Flame rectification lost during firing. Causes: dirty rod, gas pressure issues, or flooded combustion chamber.
safetyWarning: Diagnose promptly to prevent unsafe combustion.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: High Limit
shortDescription: Supply water over high limit temperature.
fullDescription: Boiler exceeded max supply temp - typically a flow issue (stuck pump, air-bound zone, bad expansion tank).
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Low Water / Pressure
fullDescription: LWCO trip or transducer reports below threshold. Check for leaks before refilling.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Vent Pressure / Air Fault
fullDescription: Inducer can't prove draft. Clear vent terminations, condensate trap, check inducer.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Supply Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Outlet sensor reporting open/short. Replace sensor.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Return Sensor / Delta-T
shortDescription: Return sensor fault or flow delta-T alarm.
fullDescription: Either return sensor bad or flow too low. Tech verifies flow and sensor.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Gas Valve Fault
fullDescription: Coil open, wiring fault, or control mismatch. Licensed gas tech only.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Combustion Blower Fault
shortDescription: Blower RPM out of spec or stalled.
fullDescription: Modulating blower monitored by RPM feedback; failure triggers E9.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech

title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: Self-diagnostic failure. Power cycle transient; persistent requires replacement.
whenToCallPro: Most boiler/water heater issues require licensed HVAC tech
